visual_brief.subject: persistent background agents and governed ongoing work
verified_context: OpenAI describes Dots as persistent agents with their own cloud computers that can keep several projects moving in the background.
The engineering significance is the control plane around ongoing work: permissions, background-action limits, approval boundaries, auditability, and interruption.
The illustration must represent persistence and governed access without depicting literal software interfaces, robots, credentials, or security claims.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Persistent delegated work continues across several bounded projects while a central governed workspace remains the stable control point.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A warm architectural complex holds several distinct work areas around one central governed hall, connected by terracotta paths and separated by visible thresholds.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected before scoring: robotic work arms make the scene too literal and violate the constitution's robot prohibition.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant layered workrooms and thresholds. Strong physical presence, but secondary detail competes with the persistence metaphor at thumbnail size.
candidate_notes.C: Selected final asset. A central governed hall is physically connected to several bounded work areas through terracotta paths and explicit thresholds. The lossless export keeps the composition text-free, non-robotic, asymmetrical, and readable at small sizes while remaining a physical architectural metaphor rather than a UI diagram.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1400 × 700 wide hero keeps the central hall, all three bounded work areas, and the controlled terracotta paths visible without crowding the focal point.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop preserves the governed central hall and enough connected thresholds to retain the persistence metaphor.
crop_review.reference_layout: The physical building masses, side faces, ground plane, and controlled paths keep the composition architectural rather than schematic while fitting the article-hero whitespace contract.
crop_review.thumbnail: At small scale the large central hall, dark arches, and terracotta connections remain a distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared palette, warm paper field, restrained terracotta emphasis, architectural mass, negative space, focal hierarchy, thumbnail silhouette, and non-interface physical presence against the current production reference set.
